policy.title: US stocks drift near their records as oil prices rise
policy.summary_zh: 美股近日在油價上升推動下維持高位,市場仍以川普政策為主線,但獲利了結跡象開始浮現。

policy.title: Dow Jones Futures: Trump Sparks Stock Market Rally; Palantir Soars On Earnings With SpaceX On Deck
policy.summary_zh: 川普政策提振股市,Palantir 財報與 SpaceX 相關題材帶動防禦與太空產業想像,但熱度能否延續仍待觀察。

policy.title: US stocks jump as employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs, raising hopes that rate hikes can wait
policy.summary_zh: 美國就業數據意外走弱(單月裁員),市場預期聯儲升息延後,科技股估值壓力暫時緩解,但經濟韌性仍需驗證。
